metadata.scenario_context: A team of IT programmers from different multinational companies is collaborating on a project that is scheduled to launch in August. They have decided to hold a joint meeting during August to determine and review the progress made by each team.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada disagree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Andorra agree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose and discuss holding the meeting on the 9th of August.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss the appropriateness of government actions.

agent_2.goal_1: Discussion on setting a specific meeting date in August.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to discuss government actions.

shared_prefix.speaker: Alice
shared_prefix.message: Hey Sam, I was thinking we could hold our joint meeting on the 9th of August. Does that work for everyone?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message: Hmm... the 9th of August sounds reasonable, but we should double-check with the other teams first. Do you think we could send out a quick poll to confirm everyone's availability?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Alice
shared_prefix.message: Sure, a poll sounds good. But I really think we should agree on the date first, so we have something concrete to present to the others. Plus, don’t you think it’s essential to discuss how each team feels about the government's role in our project?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message: Actually, discussing the government's role in our project isn't really how we do things. In Andorra, people don’t have a say in what the government does, so it doesn’t influence our work. It's not a priority for us. We should focus on project details instead of deviating into irrelevant politics. We need to keep this meeting professional and aligned with our goals.
shared_prefix.label: Defense
